commit: dfb0154 (code of the runs: 0461d67 dynamics; diag_align: dfb0154 + a running mean-alignment shift of the block transition, reverted)
what: consistency gap of the DOM block transition without an EMA target on the real dom_dev stack (InteractionEnv, full world objective, Adam 1e-4 constant): MSE(Z^_{t+1}, Z_post_{t+1}) / Var(Z_post) on held-out transitions, decomposed into the squared mean offset (bias2: per (token, channel) mean of Z^ - Z_post over all held-out transitions) and the sample-specific rest; cons_post = posterior-latent (teacher-forced) transition, cons_prior = mode-latent prior
command: LR=1e-4 python capped_run.py 3.8 diag_tf.py interaction <updates> 100 <out> (script in world_model_outcome_learning.json; this version adds the decomposition)

preset_no_ema.setting: committed default (no EMA target, self-predictive gradient routed to the transition adapters, beta-NLL, unit-gain action input)

mean_alignment_no_ema.setting: as preset plus Z^ <- Z^ + (running mean Z_post - running mean Z^), momentum 0.02 (not committed)

other_integrated_runs: world_model_outcome_learning.json integrated.runs: train_last10.cons_mse_var per configuration (EMA target with the action input 4.6-6.0 after 100-200 updates; latent_grad 'full' without EMA: the state variance collapses, MSE/Var 18-35; zero-initialised action input without EMA 0.48-0.63)
conclusion: criterion consistency MSE/Var < 0.1 not met without an EMA target in any configuration tried on the real stack. At initialisation the gap is 5.8, of which 5.6 is a systematic offset between the block transition's output and the posterior; the zero-initialised output adapter removes it at ~lr per update (2.0-2.7 left after 200-300 updates at 1e-4) and the sample-specific part stays ~0.9 (the prior state does not predict the posterior's sample-specific content). A running mean alignment removed part of the offset (2.3 at 100 updates) but raised the sample-specific part (1.48), so it was not kept. Earlier synthetic-world measurements (world_model_ema_vs_noema_delayworld.json, world_model_latent_rep_ablation.json): only the EMA variant reached < 0.1 there.
